correctness.rationale: For the explicitly given three-component mass-action polynomial flow and any compactly supported strictly positive invariant probability, stationarity of log x and log y fixes all means as common scale r. Stationarity of log z gives E(1/z)=E(z)/z_*^2, hence E[(z-z_*)^2/z]=2(Ez-z_*)>=0. The exact generator L(x-y+z)=2kappa_4-2kappa_2xy, plus stationary x,y, locks all three pair reaction fluxes to kappa_4. Subtracting products of means yields Cov(u_i,u_j)=-(r^2-1)u_{i,*}u_{j,*}. Equality forces z=z_* a.s., then x,y on one affine line; Cov(x,y)=0 on that line forces zero variance, so only equilibrium. All logs bounded on compact positive support. Strict conclusions conditional on nontrivial invariant measure, not existence at arbitrary rates.

value.rationale: A universal exact quantitative restriction on every compact positive stationary state of a natural minimal chemical oscillator: despite elevated individual means all three pair reaction fluxes are fixed and all correlations strictly negative. It predicts a nontrivial testable signature of periodic physical-time dynamics and clarifies equilibrium-versus-oscillatory statistics.
